Magma, Viridis and Inferno lookup tables in src/palettes.hpp were extracted from
Matplotlib v3.10.0's lib/matplotlib/_cm_listed.py and rounded to 8-bit RGB.

https://github.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/blob/v3.10.0/lib/matplotlib/_cm_listed.py

Copyright Matplotlib Development Team. The upstream license is in LICENSE.
Grayscale is generated directly. No Matplotlib runtime is used.
